patient._comment: 'patient' contains the three sections that may be exposed in the detailed patient display: presentation, answer, and clinical.

presentation._comment: The immutable patient evidence package available for triage. Panel context controls whether other sections are locked or available.
presentation.quote: I've had a nasty cough for days, bringing up green gunk, and now it hurts to take a deep breath on my right side. I've been feverish and totally wiped out.
presentation.triageNote: 55-year-old male with several days of productive cough, fever, fatigue, and right-sided pain on deep inspiration. He has focal right-sided crackles and egophony, respiratory rate 22, and oxygen saturation 94%.

answer._comment: The authoritative game answer. Explicit ESI, destination, and destination rationale are answer-bearing content; the player's assignment remains session state.
answer.destinationReason: ESI 3 is appropriate because a febrile lower-respiratory illness with mild hypoxemia is expected to need multiple diagnostic and treatment resources.

clinical._comment: Display-ready clinical interpretation derived from patient.presentation. It preserves clinical meaning but must not explicitly name or identify the correct ESI level or destination; it does not participate in scoring.
clinical.summary: This patient has productive cough, high fever, focal pleuritic pain, right-sided crackles and egophony, tachycardia, tachypnea, and oxygen saturation 94%.
clinical.acuityReason: He is stable without severe respiratory distress, but focal lung findings and abnormal physiology require imaging, testing, and treatment.
expectedResources: Supplemental oxygen and IV fluids as indicated
teachingPoints: Focal lung findings and pleuritic pain help distinguish lower-respiratory infection from an uncomplicated upper-respiratory illness.
Oxygenation, respiratory effort, age, comorbidity, and mental status guide disposition.

possibleClinicalOutcome.disposition: Chest imaging, testing, and antibiotics would be followed by risk-based discharge, observation, or admission depending on oxygenation and response.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.pose: seated, one hand on his right chest, mid-cough
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character, 3/4 front view, centered, square 1:1. Match the exact painterly style, brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting, and palette of the attached reference image. Subject: a white 55-year-old man, flushed and feverish, seated on a blue padded clinic chair. Pose: seated, one hand pressed to his right chest as if mid-cough. Expression: tired and unwell. Clearly visible: a hand on the right side of the chest and a flushed, feverish face. No text, no logos.
